"""Paired managed GPU FFN: same frozen shaders, old/new production runtimes."""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'fair'))
import protocol as p
import ffn_reference as ref

CASES=[(1,256),(16,256),(128,256),(1,1024),(32,1024),(128,1024),(1,2048),(32,2048)]

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output',required=True,type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--build-dir',required=True,type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--blocks',type=int,default=5)
    parser.add_argument('--target-ms',type=float,default=30)
    parser.add_argument('--reuse-build',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--profile-only',action='store_true')
    args=parser.parse_args();assert not args.output.exists()
    for name in ('KALANDRA_GPU_PROFILE','MTL_DEBUG_LAYER','MTL_SHADER_VALIDATION','DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES'):
        assert os.getenv(name) in (None,'','0'),name
    build=args.build_dir;build.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    root=p.ROOT;fair=Path(__file__).parent/'fair';compiler=root/'build/native/native/kalandra'
    baseline=root/'benchmarks/.build/ai-sequence-2026-10-28/baseline'
    task=compiler.parent/'libkalandra-task-core-optimized.a'
    metal=compiler.parent/'metal/libkalandra-metal-optimized.a'
    bundle=root/'benchmarks/.build/residual-ffn/bundle'
    old=json.loads((root/'benchmarks/results/residual-ffn-2026-10-28.json').read_text())
    shaders=list(bundle.glob('*.metallib'))
    assert shaders and all(p.sha(f)==old['artifact_sha256'][p.key(f)] for f in shaders)
    sources=[Path(__file__),fair/'ResidualFfnGpu.cpp',fair/'ResidualFfn.h',fair/'ffn_reference.py',fair/'protocol.py',root/'native/benchmarks/ResidualFfn.k',root/'native/metal/Metal.mm',root/'native/metal/Metal.h',bundle/'host.cpp']
    signature={str(f):p.sha(f) for f in sources+[compiler,task,metal,baseline/'metal.a',*shaders]}
    manifest=build/'manifest.json'
    if args.reuse_build:
        saved=json.loads(manifest.read_text());assert saved['signature']==signature
        assert all(p.sha(f)==h for f,h in saved['hashes'].items())
        p.COMMANDS.extend(saved['commands'])
    else:
        driver=build/'Driver.cpp'
        text=(fair/'ResidualFfnGpu.cpp').read_text()
        needle='resident_bytes\\\":%llu}\\n'
        assert text.count(needle)==1
        text=text.replace(needle,'resident_bytes\\\":%llu,\\\"attempts\\\":%llu}\\n')
        needle='(unsigned long long)baseline);'
        assert text.count(needle)==1
        text=text.replace(needle,'(unsigned long long)baseline,(unsigned long long)(after.attempts-before.attempts));')
        driver.write_text(text)
        for version,archive in [('baseline',baseline/'metal.a'),('current',metal)]:
            p.run([p.CLANG,'-std=c++23','-O2','-DNDEBUG','-ffp-contract=off','-pthread','-I'+str(fair),driver,archive,task,'-framework','Foundation','-framework','Metal','-o',build/version])
        saved=dict(signature=signature,commands=p.COMMANDS,driver=str(driver),hashes={str(f):p.sha(f) for f in [driver,build/'baseline',build/'current']})
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(saved,indent=2)+'\n')
    expected={};result=dict(oracle_self_test=ref.self_test(),verification=[])
    for m,d,pattern in [(3,7,1),(2,33,1),(1,257,1)]+[(m,d,0) for m,d in CASES]:
        for version in ('baseline','current'):
            for mode in range(3):
                row=json.loads(p.run([build/version,bundle,m,d,1,1,mode,pattern,1]))
                result['verification'].append(dict(version=version,mode=mode,m=m,d=d,pattern=pattern,**ref.assess(m,d,pattern,row,True)))
                if not pattern:expected.setdefault((m,d),row['result']);assert expected[m,d]==row['result']
        print(f'Verified all cells {m}x{d}, pattern {pattern}',flush=True)
    def invoke(cell,count,rounds,profile=False):
        version,mode,m,d=cell
        env=dict(os.environ,KALANDRA_GPU_PROFILE='1') if profile else None
        rows=p.observations(p.run([build/version,bundle,m,d,count,rounds,mode,0,0],env),expected[m,d],count,rounds)
        assert all(r['submissions']==r['completions'] and r['submissions']%count==0 for r in rows)
        return rows
    cells=[[v,mode,m,d] for v in ('baseline','current') for mode in range(3) for m,d in CASES]
    if args.profile_only:
        result['profiles']=[dict(cell=cell,process=process,iterations=3,samples=invoke(cell,3,3,True)) for process in range(3) for cell in (cells if process%2==0 else cells[::-1])]
    else:
        result['paired']=p.measure_paired(cells,invoke,lambda c:expected[tuple(c[2:])],blocks=args.blocks,rounds=3,target_ms=args.target_ms,adaptive=True,max_iterations=1000)
    assert {str(f):p.sha(f) for f in sources+[compiler,task,metal,baseline/'metal.a',*shaders]}==signature
    assert all(p.sha(f)==h for f,h in saved['hashes'].items())
    result.update(contract='Same complete residual FFN, source-generated frozen shader bundle, driver and task runtime. Only the Metal runtime archive changes. Mode 0 resident, 1 activation upload with resident weights, 2 all uploads. Fresh managed tasks/captures/intermediates/completion/scalar observation/cleanup included; shader loading, initialization and initial resident uploads excluded. Every shape full-cell bit checked with independent float32 tree oracle; every warmup/timed checksum checked. Profiles are separate, instrumented diagnostics, not acceptance times. No clocks/affinity/desktop isolation.',source_snapshots={p.key(f):f.read_text() for f in sources})
    p.evidence(args.output,result,sources+[Path(saved['driver'])],list(map(Path,saved['hashes']))+[metal,baseline/'metal.a',task,*shaders],compiler)

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Independent float32 operation/tree oracle and float64 forward-error checks.

No BLAS is used for the strict oracle. Every product and adjacent pair is
rounded separately; complete output matrices are checked, including timed sizes.
"""
import functools
import numpy as np

def inputs(m,d,pattern):
    def make(shape,stream):
        z=np.arange(np.prod(shape),dtype=np.uint32)+np.uint32((0x9e3779b9*(stream+1))&0xffffffff)
        z=(z^(z>>16))*np.uint32(0x85ebca6b)
        z=(z^(z>>13))*np.uint32(0xc2b2ae35)
        z=z^(z>>16)
        denominator=(127 if stream else 29) if pattern else (128 if stream else 32)
        return ((z%17).astype(np.int32)-8).astype(np.float32).reshape(shape)/np.float32(denominator)
    return make((m,d),0),make((d,4*d),1),make((4*d,d),2)

def tree(values,axis=-1):
    values=np.moveaxis(np.asarray(values,dtype=np.float32),axis,-1).copy()
    while values.shape[-1]>1:
        n=values.shape[-1]
        paired=values[...,:n-1:2]+values[...,1:n:2]
        values=np.concatenate((paired,values[...,-1:]),axis=-1) if n&1 else paired
    return values[...,0]

def strict_matmul(a,b):
    out=np.empty((a.shape[0],b.shape[1]),np.float32)
    for row in range(0,a.shape[0],4):
        for col in range(0,b.shape[1],16):
            terms=a[row:row+4,:,None]*b[None,:,col:col+16]
            out[row:row+4,col:col+16]=tree(terms,axis=1)
    return out

@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def oracle(m,d,pattern):
    x,up,down=inputs(m,d,pattern)
    hidden=np.maximum(strict_matmul(x,up),np.float32(0))
    cells=strict_matmul(hidden,down)+x
    scalar=float(tree(cells.reshape(-1)))
    # BLAS may use FMA/reassociation. Standard gamma bounds propagate the first
    # GEMM error through 1-Lipschitz ReLU and the second GEMM/residual addition.
    # float64 oracle's own smaller error is covered by doubling these bounds.
    a,b,c=(v.astype(np.float64) for v in (x,up,down))
    high_hidden=np.maximum(a@b,0)
    high=high_hidden@c+a
    u=2.0**-24
    gamma=lambda k:k*u/(1-k*u)
    e1=gamma(2*d)*(np.abs(a)@np.abs(b))
    bound=2*(e1@np.abs(c)+gamma(8*d+2)*((np.abs(high_hidden)+e1)@np.abs(c)+np.abs(a)))
    return cells,scalar,high,bound

def assess(m,d,pattern,row,strict):
    want,scalar,high,bound=oracle(m,d,pattern)
    actual=np.asarray(row['cells'],np.float32).reshape(m,d)
    assert np.isfinite(actual).all() and np.isfinite(row['result'])
    error=np.abs(actual.astype(np.float64)-high)
    assert np.all(error<=bound), (m,d,pattern,float(np.max(error-bound)))
    same=bool(np.array_equal(actual.view(np.uint32),want.view(np.uint32)))
    if strict:
        assert same, (m,d,pattern,'strict cell bits disagree',np.argwhere(actual.view(np.uint32)!=want.view(np.uint32))[:4].tolist())
        assert np.float32(row['result']).view(np.uint32)==np.float32(scalar).view(np.uint32)
    # The scalar is also validated against this backend's complete output cells.
    assert np.float32(row['result']).view(np.uint32)==tree(actual.reshape(-1)).view(np.uint32)
    return dict(cells=m*d,strict_bit_match=same,max_absolute_error=float(error.max()),
                max_error_bound=float(bound.max()),max_bound_fraction=float(np.max(error/np.maximum(bound,1e-300))),
                expected=row['result'])

def self_test():
    # Independently check vectorized product/tree semantics using scalar Python
    # binary64 (exact for each float32 product/pair), rounded at every operation.
    x,up,_=inputs(3,7,1)
    def scalar_sum(v):
        v=[np.float32(z) for z in v]
        while len(v)>1:
            v=[np.float32(float(v[i])+float(v[i+1])) for i in range(0,len(v)-1,2)]+(v[-1:] if len(v)&1 else [])
        return v[0]
    a=strict_matmul(x,up)
    for r in range(3):
        for col in range(28):
            expected=scalar_sum([np.float32(float(x[r,k])*float(up[k,col])) for k in range(7)])
            assert a[r,col].view(np.uint32)==expected.view(np.uint32)
    cells,scalar,_,_=oracle(3,7,1)
    row=dict(cells=cells.reshape(-1).tolist(),result=scalar)
    assess(3,7,1,row,True)
    row['cells'][0]+=1
    try:assess(3,7,1,row,True)
    except AssertionError:return dict(scalar_product_cells=84,corruption_rejected=True)
    raise AssertionError('corrupted cell accepted')

"""Shared repeated-process protocol; all measured and warmup outputs are validated."""
import datetime,hashlib,json,math,os,platform,random,statistics,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
CLANG=Path(json.loads((ROOT/'native/toolchain-proof/toolchain.json').read_text())['defaultLlvmRoot'])/'bin/clang++'
RUST=Path.home()/'.rustup/toolchains/stable-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin/rustc'
BUILD=ROOT/'benchmarks/.build/fair'
COMMANDS=[]
def run(argv,env=None,timeout=360):
    argv=list(map(str,argv)); COMMANDS.append(argv)
    p=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=ROOT,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
    if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError(f'{argv}: {p.returncode}\n{p.stdout}\n{p.stderr}')
    return p.stdout
def key(path):
    path=Path(path)
    return str(path.relative_to(ROOT)) if path.is_relative_to(ROOT) else str(path)
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def observations(output,expected,count,rounds):
    rows=[json.loads(x) for x in output.splitlines()]
    assert [r['round'] for r in rows]==list(range(-2,rounds)),rows
    for row in rows:
        assert math.isfinite(row['ns']) and row['ns']>=0,row
        assert type(row['checksum']) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(row['checksum']) and float(row['checksum'])==expected*count,(row,expected,count)
    return rows

def calibrate_batch(cells,invoke,target_ms,max_iterations,adaptive):
    """Use validated warm batches, including the faster member of a pair."""
    assert target_ms>0 and max_iterations>0
    count=1;history=[]
    for _ in range(12 if adaptive else 1):
        costs=[]
        for cell in cells:
            samples=invoke(cell,count,3)
            elapsed=statistics.median(r['ns'] for r in samples if r['round']>=0)
            assert math.isfinite(elapsed) and elapsed>=0
            costs.append(elapsed)
            history.append(dict(cell=cell,iterations=count,samples=samples))
        elapsed=min(costs) if adaptive else max(costs)
        if not adaptive:
            return max(1,min(max_iterations,math.ceil(target_ms*1e6/max(1,elapsed)))),history
        if elapsed>=target_ms*1e6*.8 or count==max_iterations:
            assert elapsed>0, 'batch remains below timer resolution at cap'
            return count,history
        count=min(max_iterations,max(count+1,math.ceil(count*min(32,target_ms*1e6/max(1,elapsed)))))
    raise AssertionError('batch calibration did not converge')

def measure(cells,invoke,reference,processes=3,rounds=7,target_ms=50,adaptive=False,max_iterations=20000):
    counts={};calibration=[]
    for cell in cells:
        counts[tuple(cell)],probes=calibrate_batch([cell],invoke,target_ms,max_iterations,adaptive)
        calibration.extend(probes)
    records=[];rng=random.Random(20261024)
    for trial in range(processes):
        order=list(cells);rng.shuffle(order)
        for cell in order:
            count=counts[tuple(cell)];samples=invoke(cell,count,rounds)
            assert all(s['ns']>0 for s in samples if s['round']>=0),'batch below timer resolution'
            row=dict(cell=cell,process=trial,iterations=count,samples=samples)
            records.append(row)
            median=statistics.median(r['ns']/count for r in samples if r['round']>=0)
            print(f'{trial+1}/{processes} {cell}: {median/1000:.3f} us',flush=True)
    summary=[]
    for cell in cells:
        groups=[r for r in records if r['cell']==cell]
        medians=[statistics.median(s['ns']/r['iterations'] for s in r['samples'] if s['round']>=0) for r in groups]
        summary.append(dict(cell=cell,expected=reference(cell),median_ns=statistics.median(medians),process_medians_ns=medians))
    return dict(protocol=dict(processes=processes,rounds=rounds,warmups=2,target_ms=target_ms,max_iterations=max_iterations,adaptive_batching=adaptive,seed=20261024),calibration=calibration,observations=records,summary=summary)

def measure_paired(cells,invoke,reference,blocks=9,rounds=3,target_ms=10,adaptive=False,max_iterations=20000):
    """Adjacent ABBA processes reduce drift; retain every sample and paired ratio."""
    groups={}
    for cell in cells:
        assert cell[0] in ('baseline','current')
        groups.setdefault(tuple(cell[1:]),{})[cell[0]]=cell
    assert all(set(g)=={'baseline','current'} for g in groups.values())
    counts={};calibration=[]
    for key,group in groups.items():
        counts[key],probes=calibrate_batch(list(group.values()),invoke,target_ms,max_iterations,adaptive)
        calibration.extend(probes)
    records=[];pairs=[];rng=random.Random(20261024)
    for block in range(blocks):
        order=list(groups);rng.shuffle(order)
        for key in order:
            group=groups[key];count=counts[key];medians={'baseline':[],'current':[]}
            versions=('baseline','current','current','baseline')
            if block%2:versions=('current','baseline','baseline','current')
            for slot,version in enumerate(versions):
                cell=group[version];samples=invoke(cell,count,rounds)
                assert all(s['ns']>0 for s in samples if s['round']>=0)
                median=statistics.median(s['ns']/count for s in samples if s['round']>=0)
                medians[version].append(median)
                records.append(dict(cell=cell,process=block,slot=slot,iterations=count,samples=samples))
            before=statistics.mean(medians['baseline']);after=statistics.mean(medians['current'])
            pairs.append(dict(group=list(key),block=block,baseline_ns=before,current_ns=after,
                              speedup=before/after,time_reduction=1-after/before))
            print(f'{block+1}/{blocks} {key}: {before/1000:.3f} -> {after/1000:.3f} us',flush=True)
    summary=[]
    for cell in cells:
        medians=[statistics.median(s['ns']/r['iterations'] for s in r['samples'] if s['round']>=0)
                 for r in records if r['cell']==cell]
        summary.append(dict(cell=cell,expected=reference(cell),median_ns=statistics.median(medians),
                            process_medians_ns=medians))
    return dict(protocol=dict(blocks=blocks,rounds=rounds,warmups=2,target_ms=target_ms,
        max_iterations=max_iterations,adaptive_batching=adaptive,seed=20261024,ordering='Adjacent ABBA/BAAB fresh processes; identical iterations per pair'),
        calibration=calibration,observations=records,summary=summary,pairs=pairs)

def evidence(output,data,sources,binaries,compiler):
    assert not output.exists() and not output.with_suffix('.md').exists(),'choose new output paths'
    data.update(schema=1,timestamp=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                compiler_sha256=sha(compiler),source_sha256={key(p):sha(p) for p in sources},
                artifact_sha256={key(p):sha(p) for p in binaries},commands=COMMANDS,
                revision=run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).strip(),worktree_status=run(['git','status','--short']),
                system=platform.platform(),versions=dict(python=sys.version,clang=run([CLANG,'--version']),rust=run([RUST,'--version','--verbose']),go=run(['go','version'])),
                cpu=run(['sysctl','-n','machdep.cpu.brand_string']).strip())
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);output.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')

fn cells(x: Tensor[float32, ?, ?], up: Tensor[float32, ?, ?], down: Tensor[float32, ?, ?]) -> Tensor[float32, ?, ?]:
  hidden = relu(matmul(x, up))
  matmul(hidden, down) + x

fn project(x: Tensor[float32, ?, ?], up: Tensor[float32, ?, ?], down: Tensor[float32, ?, ?]) -> float32:
  reduceSum(cells(x, up, down))

fn main() -> float32 ! TaskError:
  try parallel:
    gpu = devices.gpu()
    x: Tensor[float32, 1, 2] = tensor([[1, -2]])
    up: Tensor[float32, 2, 4] = tensor([[1, 2, -1, 0], [0, 1, 2, -1]])
    down: Tensor[float32, 4, 2] = tensor([[1, 0], [0, 1], [1, -1], [-1, 1]])
    a = try await transfer(x, gpu)
    b = try await transfer(up, gpu)
    c = try await transfer(down, gpu)
    try await spawn project(a, b, c) on gpu
